title: Dolly Parton, Effervescent Queen of Country Music and Just About Everything Else, Dies at 80
content: A shrewd dealmaker who launched Dollywood, the “Jolene” and “I Will Always Love You” singer-songwriter also starred in the films ‘9 to 5,’ ‘Steel Magnolias’ and ‘Rhinestone’ and captivated the world with her grace and wit.
